scope: Independent hotel treadmill fault scenarios only. Production physical E starts both sessions and requests stop. A recorded temporary collision fixture blocks the original dismount point; the existing capsule stays at the safe mounted position, activity time and earned work freeze, then physical E retries after fixture removal and safely returns. A second live session is externally moved using the production successful relocate_interior API; the activity releases control and removes effects without teleporting back. Existing outdoor collision inventory and player capsule remain intact. This is headless fault-path verification, not all four facility activities, native rendering, a full catalog action audit, or human OS input acceptance.
